mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'INCOME' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalIncome, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'EXPENSE' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalExpense FROM transactions t WHERE

SELECT c.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS name, c.type AS type, SUM(t.amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM transactions t JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.category_id WHERE AND t.type = 'EXPENSE' GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name, c.type ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT e.emotion_id AS emotionId, e.name AS name, e.color AS color, SUM(t.amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM transactions t JOIN emotions e ON t.emotion_id = e.emotion_id WHERE AND t.type = 'EXPENSE' GROUP BY e.emotion_id, e.name, e.color ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT slot, SUM(amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN HOUR(t.occurred_at) BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN 'DAWN' WHEN HOUR(t.occurred_at) BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN 'MORNING' WHEN HOUR(t.occurred_at) BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN 'AFTERNOON' ELSE 'NIGHT' END AS slot, t.amount AS amount FROM transactions t WHERE AND t.type = 'EXPENSE' ) s GROUP BY slot
